action.action-desc: Mr. Sean Patrick Maloney of New York introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Agriculture

form.official-title: To amend the Commodity Exchange Act with respect to the regulation of virtual currencies.

subsection.text: Section 1a of the Commodity Exchange Act (7 U.S.C. 1a) is amended by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: The term virtual currency means a digital representation of value that does not have legal tender status and that functions as a medium of exchange, a unit of account, or a store of value.

subsection.header: Requirements applicable to boards of trade
subsection.text: Section 5(d)(4) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 7(d)(4)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking all that precedes board of trade and inserting the following:
by redesignating each of subparagraphs (A) and (B) as clauses (i) and (ii), respectively, and moving each of such provisions 2 ems to the right; and
by adding after and below the end the following:

subparagraph.text: Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(B), with regard to a contract on the contract market that references a virtual currency available on a spot market platform, in order to fully comply with this paragraph, the board of trade must have—

clause.text: unconstrained access to all trade and trader data regarding the virtual currency on the spot market platform; and
the capability to provide the data to the Commission on request.

subsection.header: Requirements applicable To swap execution facilities
subsection.text: Section 5h(f)(4) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 7b–3(f)(4)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking all that precedes swap execution facility shall and inserting the following:

paragraph.header: Monitoring of trading and trade processing

paragraph.text: by redesignating each of clauses (i) and (ii) of subparagraph (A) as subclauses (I) and (II), respectively, and moving each of such provisions 2 ems to the right;
by redesignating subparagraphs (A) and (B) as clauses (i) and (ii), respectively, and moving each of such provisions 2 ems to the right; and
by adding after and below the end the following:

subparagraph.text: Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(B), with regard to a swap on the swap execution facility that references a virtual currency available on a spot market platform, in order to fully comply with this paragraph, the board of trade must have—

clause.text: unconstrained access to all trade and trader data regarding the virtual currency on the spot market platform; and
the capability to provide the data to the Commission on request.
